name: UF-vga-palette-bayer-sky
note: Locked to the standard VGA palette with Bayer 4x4 — dithered sunset skies like early VGA games. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/vga-palette-bayer-sky.  (sample: seed 1133)

form.subject: a (desert oasis:1.3), (palm trees:1.2), (glowing sunset sky:1.2)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (desert oasis:1.3), (palm trees:1.2), (glowing sunset sky:1.2), dosart_vga, 256-color VGA pixel art, scene background, adventure game, 1990s DOS game' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora dosart-vga.safetensors --lora-strength 0.8 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (user interface, hud, health bar:1.2), border' --style scene --out 320x200 --palette VGA --dither bayer4 --dither-amount 0.5 --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1133
